decision: Lead with one outcome sentence in display type, not a KPI grid
why: Partnership managers present this page to creators and leadership; the sentence is the story.
value: The program's health is quotable in one line.

decision: Commissions confirm 30 days after delivery instead of clawing back returns
why: Clawbacks damage creator trust and create negative balances to chase.
alternative: Pay on order, deduct returns later.
value: Every payout is final; the ledger never goes negative.

decision: Attribution requires both the code and creator-session evidence
why: A code alone can leak to coupon sites; the session shows the buyer actually saw the creator.
value: Leaks are detectable and commission reflects real influence.

decision: An anomaly detector flags leaks; a person decides to cap, rotate or hold
why: Rotating a creator's code affects their audience and income; that call needs context.
value: Fast detection without punishing a creator for going viral.

decision: Campaigns shown as a week calendar beside the numbers
why: Spikes only make sense next to what was scheduled that day.
value: A spike on a non-campaign day stands out immediately.
